summary: Nymox Pharmaceutical Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a special shareholders' meeting held August 26-28, 2026, to elect five directors. Of 105,040,140 shares outstanding, 47,885,624 (45.59%) were voted; the director election motion received 98.29% in favor. The meeting was routine corporate governance, with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or strategic changes. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of meeting results, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or transactions were disclosed; the event is ordinary board election with no unusual circumstances warranting a special-situations classification.
